info.title: Bike Surgeon API
info.description: Customer API (/v1, bearer token from OTP login) for the Bike Surgeon app, and Integration API (/integration/v1, X-Api-Key) for the workshop's CRM/ERP. Money is in Indian rupees; estimates are before GST. See docs/ in the repository for guides.

apiKey.name: X-Api-Key
apiKey.description: One of the keys in INTEGRATION_API_KEYS

token.description: OneSignal subscription id, or the FCM/APNs device token

stage.description: Index into the tracker's stages (0–6), -1 when cancelled

estimateAmount.description: Package price after discount, before GST

JobStatus.description: booked → rider_assigned → picked_up → at_workshop → in_service → job_closed → delivered, or cancelled. Visits skip the rider steps.

PayResult.description: pendingPayment is set when the remainder needs confirming by the payment gateway or ERP

method.description: How the rest is paid. Required when the wallet does not cover the balance.

targetScreen.description: App screen name to open, e.g. "Part approval"

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null on the last page

nextUpdatedSince.description: Deprecated: use nextCursor. Can skip rows that share a timestamp.

force.description: Allow moving backwards. Forward moves, including skipped stages, never need it.

Assignment.description: Send only the fields that change. null clears a field.

partName.description: Needed unless partNo is sent; then the Inventory's name is used

amount.description: Needed unless partNo is sent; then MRP less the customer discount, times quantity

partNo.description: Part number in the Bike Surgeon Inventory
